llinyn: llinyn (llinyn) — string, cord, rope; noun m. (ac wrth y llinyn 'and by the cord'); radical after the masculine article y
wanas: gwanas (gwanas) — peg, stake, holdfast, support; noun f. (ar y wanas 'on the peg', where the glove is hung by its string); soft-mutated (gw>w) after the feminine article y
lleidyr: lleidr (lleidr) — thief; noun m. (Lleidyr, heb ynteu 'a thief, said he'; lleidyr a geueis 'a thief I caught'); radical
lledratta: lledratta (lladrata) — to steal, thieve; verbal noun (yn lledratta arnaf 'stealing from me'; a lledratta a wnaeth 'and he stole', verbal noun + a wnaeth); radical after yn and after a
leidyr: lleidr (lleidr) — thief; noun m., the same word as lleidyr; soft-mutated (ll>l) after ryw 'kind of' (pa ryw leidyr 'what kind of thief')
allut: gallu (gallu) — to be able; 2 sg. imperfect 'you could' (Pa ryw leidyr ... a allut ti y dodi y'th uanec? 'what kind of thief could you put in your glove?'); soft-mutated (g lost) after the relative particle a, following the fronted question phrase
lygryssit: llygru (llygru) — to spoil, damage, corrupt; impersonal pluperfect -yssit 'it had been spoiled' (ual yr lygryssit 'how it had been spoiled'); soft-mutated (ll>l) after the perfective particle ry, written yr here
diuwynyssit: diuwyno (difwyno) — to spoil, despoil, lay waste; impersonal pluperfect -yssit 'had been laid waste' (ac y diuwynyssit y grofdeu 'and how the crofts had been laid waste'); radical after the particle y
grofdeu: kroft (croft) — croft, small field; noun f., plural grofdeu (modern croftau) in -eu; written with g as the word's own spelling (as grofd in this part), not a mutation, since the article does not soften a plural
diwethaf: diwethaf (diwethaf) — last, latest; superlative adjective from diwedd 'end' (y'r grofd diwethaf 'to the last croft'); follows its noun, no mutation
deleis: dala (dal) — to catch, seize, hold; 1 sg. preterite 'I caught' (ac a deleis 'and which I caught'); after the relative a the d is softened (d>dd), not shown in the spelling
grogaf: crogi (crogi) — to hang; 1 sg. present/future 'I will hang' (ac a grogaf inheu 'and I will hang it'); soft-mutated (c>g) after the particle a
as: a + 's (no modern form) — the preverbal particle a carrying the infixed object pronoun 's 'them', after bei 'if' (bei as caffwn oll 'if I could get them all'; bei as caffwnn i wy oll, where wy 'them' takes the pronoun up again); the infixed pronoun causes no mutation
crogwn: crogi (crogi) — to hang; 1 sg. imperfect, here conditional 'I would hang' (mi a'y crogwn 'I would hang them'; onys crogwn 'if I did not hang them'); radical (the infixed 'y and 's 'them' cause no mutation)
anwymp: anwymp (no modern form) — unseemly, unbecoming; predicate adjective, an- 'un-' + gwymp 'fine, fitting', gw softened to w in the compound (anwymp yw guelet gwr kyuurd yn crogi 'it is unseemly to see a man of rank hanging')
kymoned: kymoned (no modern form; cf. bonedd) — of equal birth, of like lineage; adjective, kyf- 'co-, equal' + boned 'lineage', the b absorbed into the prefix (kyf- + b > kym-) (gwr kyuurd, kymoned, a thidi 'a man of equal rank and birth with you')
thidi: ti + di (tydi) — you; 2 sg. pronoun with the affixed di, 'you yourself' (a thidi 'with you'); spirant-mutated (t>th) after a 'with, as' (kyuurd a thidi 'as equal in rank as you')
crogi: crogi (crogi) — to hang; verbal noun (yn crogi y ryw bryf hwnnw 'hanging that kind of creature'); radical after yn; its object is also unmutated
bryf: pryf (pryf) — creature, vermin, worm; noun m., here a contemptuous 'creature' for the mouse; soft-mutated (p>b) after ryw 'kind of' (y ryw bryf hwnnw 'that kind of creature')
gwnelut: gwneuthur (gwneud) — to do, make; 2 sg. imperfect subjunctive 'you were to do' (phei gwnelut iawn 'and if you did right'); radical
ymyrrut: ymyrru (ymyrryd) — to meddle, interfere, concern oneself; 2 sg. imperfect subjunctive/conditional 'you would meddle' (nyt ymyrrut yn y pryf 'you would not meddle with the creature'); no mutation
pryf: pryf (pryf) — creature, vermin; noun m. (yn y pryf, y pryf hwnnw 'the creature'; pryf a welaf 'a creature I see'); radical after the article y and as a fronted word
caffwnn: caffael (cael) — to get; 1 sg. imperfect subjunctive 'I were to get' (bei as caffwnn i wy oll 'if I were to get them all'), a spelling of caffwn with -nn; radical (infixed 's causes no mutation)
crogaf: crogi (crogi) — to hang; 1 sg. present/future 'I will hang' (mi a'e crogaf 'I will hang it'); radical, since the infixed 'e 'it' causes no mutation
borth: porth (porth) — help, protection, defender; noun m., a different word from porth 'gate' (bot yn borth y'r pryf 'to be protector for the creature'); soft-mutated (p>b) after predicative yn
goglyt: gogelyd (gochel) — to guard against, avoid; verbal noun, gogelyd with the middle vowel dropped (namyn goglyt ansyberwyt y ti 'but guarding against discourtesy to you'); radical
defnyd: defnyd (defnydd) — material, cause, reason; noun m., here 'reason, ground' (defnyd yn y byt y dylyut ... 'any reason in the world why you ought ...'); modern defnydd means 'material, use'; no mutation after bei gwypwn inheu
dylyut: dylyu (dylu) — to owe, be bound to, ought; 2 sg. imperfect subjunctive 'you ought' (y dylyut titheu bot yn borth 'that you should be protector'); radical after the particle y
danaw: am + danaw (amdano) — 'about him, about it'; conjugated preposition, 3 sg. m., written as two words (am danaw); danaw is the conjugating element, whose origin (dan-?) is uncertain; no mutation
chanys: kan (can) + nys (nis) — 'since … not … it': kan 'since' with the negative ny and the infixed object 's 'it' (a chanys gwnn 'and since I do not know it'); the Red Book has a chanys nys gwnn, so the White Book may instead have lost a nys after chanys; kan spirant-mutated (k>ch) after a 'and'; compare Kanys gollyngy (Red Book Kan nys gollynghy)
llygoden: llygoden (llygoden) — mouse; noun f., plural llygot (y llygoden 'the mouse'; a'r llygoden gantaw 'and the mouse with him'); ll stays unmutated after the article
sengi: sengi (sengi) — to tread, trample, press down, thrust in; verbal noun (a sengi dwy forch 'and pressing/planting two forks'); meaning here a little uncertain; radical after a (s does not mutate)
forch: fforch (fforch) — fork, forked post; noun f., written forch with f for ff (dwy forch 'two forks'); ff has no soft mutation, so the softening after dwy cannot show; plural ffyrch (written fyrch)
uchaf: uchaf (uchaf) — highest, uppermost; superlative of uchel 'high' (yn y lle uchaf 'in the highest place'); follows its noun, radical
yscolheic: ysgolhaig (ysgolhaig) — scholar, clerk, learned man; noun m. (yr yscolheic 'the clerk'); radical
hydreul: hydreul (hydraul) — worn out, threadbare; adjective, hy- + treul 'wear', t softened to d in the compound (hen dillat hydreul 'old threadbare clothes')
tlawt: tlawt (tlawd) — poor, wretched; adjective (hydreul, tlawt 'worn, poor'); after a plural noun, radical
pedwardyn: pedwar dyn (pedwar dyn) — four persons; pedwar 'four' + dyn 'person' written as one word, 'the four (persons)' (y pedwardyn y buassynt y gyt 'the four who had been together'); noun m. collective; radical
buassynt: bot (bod) — to be; 3 pl. pluperfect 'they had been' (y buassynt y gyt 'who had been together'); radical after the relative particle y, which does not mutate
doaf: dyuot (dod) — to come; 1 sg. present 'I come' (Pan doaf o Loygyr 'from where I come, from England'); no mutation
ganu: canu (canu) — to sing, chant; verbal noun, here 'singing' as a cleric's work (o ganu 'from singing'); soft-mutated (c>g) after o 'from'
phaham: paham (pam) — why, for what; interrogative adverb; spirant-mutated (p>ph) after a 'and' (a phaham y gouynhy di 'and why do you ask')
gouynhy: gouyn (gofyn) — to ask; 2 sg. present 'you ask' (y gouynhy di 'that you ask'), -hy being the 2 sg. ending; radical after the particle y
diholedic: diholedic (deoledig) — banished, exiled, outcast; adjective, from diholi/deol 'banish' (pedwar dyn diholedic 'four outcast men'); radical
wyte: bot (bod) — to be; 2 sg. present 'you are' (yd wyte yndaw 'you are in it'), with an attached te, a form of the pronoun ti (uncertain); no mutation after yd
ba: pa (pa) — what, which; interrogative, a variant spelling with b (Ba ryw leidyr 'what kind of thief'; cf. byhyt for py hyt); whether b is a mutation here is uncertain; causes soft mutation of a following noun
ymodi: ymodi (no modern form) — properly 'stir, move'; here 'handle, busy oneself with', a sense taken from the context; verbal noun (gueda ... ymodi pryf kyfryw a hwnnw 'it suits ... to handle such a creature'; yn ymodi y pryf hwnnw 'handling that creature'); the Red Book has teimlaw 'touch, handle' in both places; no mutation
gellwg: gollwng (gollwng) — to loose, release; 2 sg. imperative 'let go!' (Gellwg e ymdeith ef 'Let it go away'), the spelling gellwg lacking the n of gellwng; radical
ellynghaf: gollwng (gollwng) — to loose, release; 1 sg. present/future 'I will let go' (Na ellynghaf 'I will not release'); g lost by soft mutation after the negative na; -h- is a spelling
chyfreith: kyfreith (cyfraith) — law, legal custom; noun f. (a chyfreith lleidyr a wnaf 'and the law of a thief I will do'); spirant-mutated (k>ch) after a 'and'
grogi: crogi (crogi) — to hang; verbal noun (y grogi 'its hanging', to hang it); soft-mutated (c>g) after y 'its, his', the possessive standing for the object
punt: punt (punt) — pound (money); noun f. (punt a geueis i 'a pound that I got'; seith punt 'seven pounds'); radical
gardotta: cardota (cardota) — to beg; verbal noun (o gardotta 'by begging'); soft-mutated (c>g) after o 'by, through'
gellwng: gollwng (gollwng) — to loose, release; 2 sg. imperative 'release!' (a gellwng y pryf hwnnw e ymdeith 'and release that creature'), though a verbal noun 'releasing' is possible (uncertain); g radical, as a 'and' gives only spirant mutation of c, p, t
guerthaf: gwerthu (gwerthu) — to sell; 1 sg. present/future 'I will sell' (nys guerthaf 'I will not sell it'); radical (infixed 's causes no mutation); gu = gw
hagyr: hagr (hagr) — ugly, unseemly, shameful; adjective, predicate (ony bei hagyr guelet gwr kyuurd ... 'if it were not unseemly to see a man of rank ...'); radical
teimlaw: teimlaw (teimlo) — to feel, touch, handle; verbal noun (yn teimlaw y ryw bryf a hwnnw 'handling that kind of creature'); radical after yn
torei: torri (torri) — to break; here in the sense 'matter to, concern'; 3 sg. imperfect, conditional (ny'm torei 'it would not concern me'); radical after the infixed 'm
dulath: dulath (no modern form) — crossbeam, the bar laid across the two forks of the gallows; noun, second element llath 'rod, beam' (ll softened to l in the compound), the first element not clear (dodi y dulath yn y fyrch 'putting the crossbeam in the forks'); radical after the article y
fyrch: fforch (fforch) — fork, forked post; plural ffyrch, written fyrch with f for ff (yn y fyrch 'in the forks', the two posts set up on the mound); ff has no soft mutation
offeirat: offeirat (offeiriad) — priest; noun m. (nachaf offeirat 'behold a priest'); radical
gyweir: kyweir (cyweir) — in good order, well-equipped, arrayed; adjective, predicative after yn (ar uarch yn gyweir 'on a horse well-equipped'); soft-mutated (k>g) after yn
uendith: bendith (bendith) — blessing; noun f.; soft-mutated (b>u, = f) after 'th 'your' (a'th uendith 'and your blessing'), after dy (dy uendith) and after y 'his' (y uendith 'his blessing')
bendith: bendith (bendith) — blessing; noun f. (Bendith Duw it 'God's blessing to you'); radical, sentence-initial
prynaf: prynu (prynu) — to buy, redeem, ransom; 1 sg. present/future 'I will buy' (mi a'y prynaf 'I will buy it'; 'y 'it' is the mouse, as the pryf or llygoden); radical (infixed 'y causes no mutation)
uyghyffes: kyffes (cyffes) — confession, avowal; noun f.; nasal-mutated (c>ngh) after uy 'my', written uyghyffes (y dygaf uyghyffes 'I bring my confession')
werthu: gwerthu (gwerthu) — to sell; verbal noun (na'y werthu 'nor selling it'); soft-mutated (gw>w) after 'y 'its', the possessive standing for the noun's object
ollwng: gollwng (gollwng) — to loose, release; verbal noun (na'y ollwng nas gwnaf i 'nor releasing it will I do'); g lost by soft mutation after 'y 'its', the possessive standing for the object
ymhalogi: ymhalogi (ymhalogi) — to defile oneself, pollute oneself, soil one's hands; verbal noun (yn ymhalogi wrth y pryf hwnnw 'defiling yourself with that creature'); radical after yn
gollwng: gollwng (gollwng) — to loose, release; imperative 2 sg. 'release!' (gollwng ef e ymdeith 'let it go away') · also 3 sg. present 'he releases' after the particle y (Ac yna y gollwng hi 'and then he releases her'); radical
maglu: maglu (maglu) — to snare, tie in a noose, entangle; verbal noun (maglu y llinin am uynwgyl y llygoden 'to noose the cord about the mouse's neck'), verbal-noun narrative after sef a wnaeth; radical
rwtter: rwtter (no modern form) — company, train, retinue; noun, probably borrowed from English (compare rout 'company'), the form not certain; gender not clear (llyma rwtter escob 'behold a bishop's train'); r shows no mutation after llyma
escob: esgob (esgob) — bishop; noun m., genitive after rwtter (rwtter escob 'a bishop's retinue'); radical
swmereu: swmer (swmer) — pack, load, sumpter-load; noun m., plural swmereu (a'y swmereu 'and his packs'); radical (the infixed possessive 'y 'his' does not alter s)
escop: esgob (esgob) — bishop; noun m., spelt escop with p (yr escop e hun 'the bishop himself'; Arglwyd escop 'lord bishop'); radical
gohir: gohir (gohirio) — to delay, hold back; verbal noun (gohir ar y weith 'delaying over the work'), also noun 'delay' (heb ohir 'without delay'); radical after sef a wnaeth
doethwyf: dyuot (dod) — to come; 1 sg. 'I have come', used as a perfect (can doethwyf i ar diuetha 'since I have come upon the destroying'); built on the stem doeth- with the 1 sg. ending -wyf, its exact analysis not certain; the Red Book has deuthum; radical after can
dielw: dielw (dielw) — unprofitable, worthless; adjective, di- 'without' + elw 'profit' (pryf mor dielw 'so worthless a creature'); d would be softened (d>dd) after mor, not shown in spelling
geffy: caffael (cael) — to get; 2 sg. present/future 'you will get' (ti a geffy hynny 'you will get that'; a'r da a geffy 'and the goods that you will get'); soft-mutated (c>g) after the particle a; = gehy
gollyngy: gellwng (gollwng) — to loose, release; 2 sg. present/future 'you will release' (Kanys gollyngy yr hynny 'since you will not release it for that': Kanys = kan 'since' + nys 'not … it', the Red Book Kan nys gollynghy); radical after the infixed 's
pedeirpunt: pedeir punt (pedair punt) — four pounds; pedeir (f. of pedwar) + punt written as one word (pedeirpunt ar ugeint 'four pounds on twenty' = twenty-four pounds); radical, unsoftened although it 'to you' stands between it and the verb (contrast deir punt), and so in the Red Book
ugeint: ugeint (ugain) — twenty; numeral m. (ar ugeint 'on twenty' = 'and twenty'); no mutation
gymeint: kymeint (cymaint) — as much, so much; noun (yr y gymeint arall 'for its as-much again', twice as much); soft-mutated (k>g) after y 'its'
collyghy: gellwng (gollwng) — to loose, release; 2 sg. present/future 'you will release' (Canys collyghy yr hynny 'since you will not release it for that', the Kanys gollyngy of two lines before; the Red Book Kan nys gellyngy); c for g and gh for ngh are spellings, not mutations; radical after the infixed 's
swmer: swmer (swmer) — pack, load, sumpter-load; noun m. (seith swmer yssyd yma, ar y seith meirch y maent arnunt 'seven packs that are here, on the seven horses they are on'); singular after a numeral; radical
rydhau: rydhau (rhyddhau) — to free, release; verbal noun (rydhau Riannon a Phryderi 'freeing Rhiannon and Pryderi'); radical
phryderi: Pryderi (Pryderi) — proper name, Pryderi son of Pwyll and Rhiannon; spirant-mutated (p>ph) after a 'and' (a Phryderi 'and Pryderi')
uynhy: mynnu (mynnu) — to want, wish; 2 sg. present 'you want' (Beth a uynhy ditheu 'what do you want'); soft-mutated (m>u, = f) after the relative a 'what'
lledrith: lledrith (lledrith) — illusion, enchantment, shape-changing; noun m. (yr hut a'r lledrith 'the enchantment and the illusion'); radical after the article 'r; also spelt lletrith
ellyngaf: gollwng (gollwng) — to loose, release; 1 sg. present/future 'I will release' (Na ellyngaf 'I will not release'), spelt without h; g lost by soft mutation after na
phy: pei (pe) — if; a variant spelling with y (a phy ny bei hynny 'and if it were not for that'); spirant-mutated (p>ph) after a 'and'
dillyngwn: dillwng (dillwng) — to loose, let go, release; 1 sg. imperfect subjunctive/conditional 'I would release' (nys dillyngwn 'I would not release her'); radical (infixed 's causes no mutation)
gyffuryf: kyffuryf (cyffurf) — form, manner, way; noun (pa gyffuryf y doeth hi attaf i 'in what manner did she come to me'); soft-mutated (k>g) after pa
herwa: herwa (herwa, from herw 'raid') — to go raiding, plunder, harry; verbal noun after y 'to' (Y herwa 'to plunder'); meaning from context, with some uncertainty; no mutation
kil: cil (cil) — nook, retreat, corner; noun m., first element of the place-name Kil Coet 'Cil Coed' (Llwyt uab Kil Coet); radical
dieleis: dial (dial) — to avenge; 1 sg. preterite 'I avenged' (ar Pryderi y dieleis i guare broch yghot 'on Pryderi I avenged the game of badger in the bag'); radical after the particle y
yghot: yn (yn) + cot (cod) — 'in the bag'; written as one word, the nasal mutation (c>ngh) of cot after yn (guare broch yghot 'badger-in-the-bag')
aghynghor: anghynghor (anghyngor) — bad counsel, ill advice; noun m., an- 'un-' + kynghor; the k is nasal-mutated (k>ngh) after the prefix, the n being dropped in writing (o aghynghor 'out of ill counsel')
clybot: clybot (clywed) — to hear; verbal noun (guedy clybot dy uot yn kyuanhedu 'after hearing that you were settling'); radical after guedy
kyuanhedu: kyuanhedu (cyfanheddu) — to dwell in, settle; verbal noun (yn kyuanhedu y wlat 'settling the land'); radical after yn
rithyaw: rithiaw (rhithio) — to change the shape of, transform; verbal noun (eu rithyaw yn llygot 'to transform them into mice'); radical (eu 'their' causes none)
diuayssant: diua (difa) — to destroy; 3 pl. preterite -yssant 'they destroyed' (ac y diuayssant y dwy grofd 'and they destroyed the two crofts'); radical after the particle y
rithaw: rithiaw (rhithio) — to change the shape of, transform; verbal noun, a variant of rithyaw (y erchi im eu rithaw 'to ask me to transform them'); radical
ritheis: rithiaw (rhithio) — to change the shape of, transform; 1 sg. preterite 'I transformed' (ac y ritheis inheu 'and I transformed them'); radical after the particle y
nis: ny (ni) + 's — negative particle with infixed 3 sg. f. object pronoun 'not her' (nis gordiwedut ti 'you would not overtake her'); a spelling variant beside nys; no mutation
gordiwedut: gordiwes (gorddiwes) — to overtake, catch up with; 2 sg. imperfect subjunctive 'you would overtake' (nis gordiwedut ti); radical (the infixed 's causes none)
waredaf: gwaret (gwared) — to deliver, rid, remove; 1 sg. present/future 'I will remove' (ac a waredaf yr hut 'and I will remove the enchantment'); soft-mutated (gw>w) after the particle a
lletrith: lledrith (lledrith) — illusion, enchantment, shape-changing; noun m., spelt with t (a waredaf yr hut a'r lletrith 'I will remove the enchantment and the illusion'); radical after the article 'r
uenegeis: menegi (mynegi) — to tell, relate; 1 sg. preterite 'I told' (Minheu a uenegeis yti 'and I told you'); soft-mutated (m>u, = f) after the particle a
ymdiala: ymdial (ymddial) — vengeance, revenge; noun m. (na bo ymdiala ar Pryderi 'that there be no vengeance on Pryderi'); the final -a is uncertain (perhaps a verbal-noun ending); radical
medreist: medru (medru) — to hit (a mark), know how; 2 sg. preterite 'you hit' (da y medreist 'well have you hit', you have hit the mark); radical after the particle y
metrut: medru (medru) — to hit (a mark), know how; 2 sg. imperfect subjunctive 'you had hit' (Bei na metrut hynny 'had you not hit on that'), written with t; m left unsoftened after na
nodeis: nodi (nodi) — to appoint, fix, stipulate; 1 sg. preterite 'I stipulated' (y nodeis inheu 'I stipulated'); radical after the particle y
rytha: rydhau (rhyddhau) — to free, release; 2 sg. imperative 'free!' (Rytha weithon wy gwreic im 'free my wife now for me'), spelt with t; radical
rydhaaf: rydhau (rhyddhau) — to free, release; 1 sg. present/future 'I will free' (Na rydhaaf 'I will not free'); r stands for rh, so no mutation is visible after na
welwyf: gwelet (gweld) — to see; 1 sg. present subjunctive 'I see' (yny welwyf Pryderi 'until I see Pryderi'); soft-mutated (gw>w) after yny 'until'
graessawu: graessawu (croesawu) — to welcome; verbal noun (a'y graessawu 'and welcoming them'); g- is the word's own initial in this spelling, as in grayssaw, not a mutation
wrda: gwrda (gwrda) — good man, worthy man; noun m., vocative (A wrda 'good sir'); soft-mutated (gw>w) after the vocative particle a
ngwreic: gwreic (gwraig) — wife, woman; noun f.; nasal-mutated (g>ng) after uy 'my' (uy ngwreic 'my wife')
nodeist: nodi (nodi) — to appoint, fix, stipulate; 2 sg. preterite 'you stipulated' (a nodeist 'what you stipulated'); radical after the relative a
trewis: taraw (taro) — to strike; 3 sg. preterite 'he struck' (y trewis ynteu hi a hudlath 'he struck her with a magic wand'); radical after the particle y
hudlath: hudlath (hudlath) — magic wand; noun f., hut 'magic' + llath 'rod', ll softened to l in the compound (a hudlath 'with a magic wand'); h is not mutated by a 'with'
datrithwys: datrithaw (datrithio) — to un-transform, restore to one's own shape; 3 sg. preterite in -wys 'he restored' (y datrithwys hi yn wreigyang 'he turned her back into a young woman'), dat- 'un-' + rithaw; radical after the particle y
wreigyang: gwreigyang (no modern form; cf. gwraig ieuanc) — young woman; noun f., gwreic + ieuanc 'young' in close compound (the Red Book has wreic ieuanc); soft-mutated (gw>w) after predicative yn 'into, as' (yn wreigyang 'into a young woman')
geccaf: teccaf (tecaf) — fairest; superlative of tec (teg); written geccaf, a readable scribal slip for deccaf (the Red Book and the second witness have deccaf); softened (t>d) as an adjective after the feminine singular noun (yn wreigyang deccaf a welsei neb 'into the fairest young woman anyone had seen')
anhedeu: anhed (annedd) — dwelling, habitation; noun m., plural anhedeu (modern anheddau) (yr holl anhedeu 'all the dwellings'); radical after holl
gyuanhed: kyuanhed (cyfanhedd) — inhabited, settled; here adjective, predicative after yn (yn gyuanhed 'inhabited'); soft-mutated (k>g) after yn
alauoed: alaw (alaf) — wealth in cattle, herds; plural alauoed (alafoedd) (o'y holl alauoed 'with all its herds'); radical after holl (vowel)
hanedeu: anhed (annedd) — dwelling; plural anedeu (a'y hanedeu 'and its dwellings'); h- prefixed after y 'her, its' (the land, gwlat f.)
wassanaeth: gwassanaeth (gwasanaeth) — service, duty, office; noun m. (Pa ryw wassanaeth 'what kind of service'); soft-mutated (gw>w) after ryw 'kind of'
yrd: ord (gordd) — sledge-hammer, mallet; noun f., plural yrd (gyrdd) (ac yrd porth uy llys i 'with the gate-hammers of my court'); what the gate-hammers were (knockers or mallets) is not certain; radical after ac 'with'
mynweireu: mynweir (mynwair) — collar, neck-band; noun, mwn 'neck' + gweir 'band, loop'; plural mynweireu (mynweireu yr essynn 'the collars of the asses'); radical
essynn: asyn (asyn) — ass, donkey; plural essynn (spelt with ss, nn) 'asses' (yr essynn 'the asses'); the plural form is uncertain; radical after the article
bydyn: bot (bod) — to be; 3 pl. habitual imperfect 'they used to be, had been' (wedy bydyn yn kywein gueir 'after they had been carting hay'), a slip for bydynt or a 3 pl. without -t (the Red Book has bydynt); radical after wedy
kywein: cywain (cywain) — to gather, carry in, haul; verbal noun (yn kywein gueir 'carrying hay'); the sense is uncertain; radical after yn
gueir: gwair (gwair) — hay; noun m. (kywein gueir 'carrying hay'), gu = gw; the sense is uncertain (the Red Book has geir); radical as object
mynwgyl: mynwgyl (mynwgl) — neck; noun m. (am y mynwgyl hitheu 'about her neck'); radical after y 'her' (the mutation of y 'her' is spirant/h-, not soft, so m stays)
kyuarwydyt: kyuarwydyt (cyfarwyddyd) — tale, story, storytelling (the old sense; the modern word means 'guidance'); noun m. (y kyuarwydyt hwnnw 'that tale'); radical after the article
mabinogi: mabinogi (mabinogi) — the Mabinogi; noun m., here the title in Mabinogi Mynweir a Mynord; the original meaning (tale of youth?) is disputed; radical
mynweir: mynweir (mynwair) — collar, neck-band; noun, mwn 'neck' + gweir 'band'; in the title Mabinogi Mynweir a Mynord 'the Mabinogi of Collar and Hammer' (Red Book mynnweir), for Rhiannon's ass-collars; radical
mynord: mynord (no modern form) — apparently a neck-hammer, mwn 'neck' + ord 'hammer' (cf. Pryderi's yrd porth); second element of the title Mabinogi Mynweir a Mynord; the Red Book has mynoad, a different form of unclear sense; meaning not certain; radical
mabinogy: mabinogi (mabinogi) — the Mabinogi; noun m., spelt with -y (o'r Mabinogy 'of the Mabinogi'); radical after the article 'r

__broaden__.y: y — (1) the article 'the' (y llys); (2) 'his, her, its' (y uryt: soft mutation = his; y hymdidan: h-prefix = her); (3) 'to' (y hela, y gyuoeth); (4) preverbal particle after a fronted adverb or object (yno y bu, Pwyll... a oed); (5) the relative in oblique relations (o'r a welsei) · (6) 'from' in y gan, y wrth 'from, compared with' (y gan y uarch 'from his horse'; y wrth y ffryt hi 'compared with her form'); (7) infixed object 'him, her, it' after a (a'y guelei 'who saw her'); (8) in a'y kymriw it is the second letter of ae 'either' (see a) · also (9) y am, y amdanaw 'from about, off' (y amdanaw 'off him'); y am hynny 'around that, beyond that, besides' · also (10) 'their' (for eu), with no mutation (y bot 'their being'; y kymryt 'their taking' = to take them) · also (11) 'in' (y'th wlat ti 'in your country') · (12) the particle y before mae introducing a reported fact (y may brawt … a wnaeth hynny 'that it is a brother who did that') · also (13) for predicative yn 'as', with soft mutation (Mi a rodaf Duw y uach it 'I give God as surety to you'; the Red Book yn vach) · (14) y ar 'from off' (y ar seith cantref Dyuet 'from off the seven cantrefs of Dyfed') · also y 'its, his' before a verbal noun, standing for the noun's object and softening it (na'y werthu 'nor selling it'; na'y ollwng 'nor releasing it')
__broaden__.yr: yr — (1) the article 'the' before a vowel (yr erchwys); (2) 'for, for the sake of' preposition (yr Duw 'for God's sake', yr guaret gormes 'for removing the oppression') · (3) 'for all, however' before an equative-type noun and a clause (yr araued y kerdei y uarch 'for all the slowness with which his horse went'); (4) in yr meityn 'for a while (since)'; (5) the verbal particle y, yd, written yr before a vowel (yr ymordiwedei a hi 'that he would overtake her') · also (6) the perfective particle ry written yr, softening the verb (yr gyscwys 'has slept'); the article before an independent possessive (yr eidunt 'theirs'); 'for' with an abstract noun (yr bychanet 'for the smallness') · also the article before hwnn, honn, 'the one' (yr hwnn y tu a Chernyw 'the one on the side towards Cornwall'; yr honn a uu tryded anuat paluawt 'the one that was the third unfortunate blow') · also yr (er) 'for all' before the relative a (yr a welsynt o ouut 'for all the grief they had seen') · also the article before a consonant in kyrchu yr gaer 'making for the fort' (read as the article, as the second witness takes it) · yr pan 'since' (yr pan welsei ef 'since he had seen'); the verb after it is soft-mutated
__broaden__.yn: yn — (1) 'in' (yn Arberth; nasal mutation: yn nyblyc); (2) predicative 'as' with soft mutation (yn wisc hela, yn arglwyd); (3) with a verbal noun, progressive (yn dyuot 'coming'); (4) before an adjective, adverbial (yn llawen 'gladly') · (5) yn yd 'to where' (ymchwelut yn yd oed Pwyll 'returning to where Pwyll was') · also yn yd 'as, while, when' (Ac yn yd aeth pawb ym pen yr arueu 'and while all went to arms'; the sense uncertain) · also 'our', a spelling of an (ein), with no mutation (yn anniuer ninheu 'our own company'; yn ymborth 'our sustenance'; yn diuetha 'our destroying') · also 'into' with rithyaw (eu rithyaw yn llygot 'to change them into mice')
__broaden__.ar: ar — (1) preposition 'on, upon; at' (ar Hafgan; ar y carw; ar y gilyd 'against the other'); (2) the article yr after a vowel, 'that which' (noc ar a uu 'than what was'; Ar ny del 'and whoever does not come') · also (3) 'with, accompanied by' (ar y ganuet marchauc 'with his hundred horsemen'); 'in' (ar y ssynnwyr e hun 'in his own senses'; ar perued y digrifwch 'in the middle of the merriment'); ar neill law Pwyll 'on one side of Pwyll'; ar uyrr 'quickly'; ar hynny 'thereupon' (see yny) · also 'over' (ar yr ynys hon 'over this island'); 'after the manner of' (ar ureint kyweirdeb 'in the manner of the arrangement'); 'on' a decision (disgynnu ar gymryt hynny 'settled on taking that'); 'ar ol' 'after' (ar ol Matholwch 'after Matholwch'); ar dec 'on ten' (see dec) · also 'concerning, about', where am would be expected (ac ar Yspydaut Benn 'and concerning the Hospitality of the Head'; the Red Book also ar) · ar + verbal noun, 'to, in order to' (doethwyf i ar diuetha y pryf 'I have come to destroy the creature')
__broaden__.wrth: wrth (wrth) — to, towards, according to; preposition, base form (dywedut... wrthaw) · also 'at' (wrth y danned 'at the teeth'; wrth yr ascwrn 'at the bone') and 'because of' (wrth hynny 'for that reason') · also 'with, over' (yn ymhalogi wrth y pryf hwnnw 'defiling yourself with that creature'); in ac wrth y llinyn 'and by the cord' the sense is uncertain
__broaden__.uanec: maneg (maneg) — glove; noun f. (spelt manec); soft-mutated (m>u, = f) after y, whether the feminine article or 'his' (yn y uanec 'in his glove') · also soft after dy, 'th 'your' (y'th uanec 'in your glove')
__broaden__.wneuthur: gwneuthur (gwneud) — to do, make; verbal noun (y wneuthur kynnadeu at Pwyll 'to send envoys to Pwyll', literally 'to make messengers'); soft-mutated (gw>w) after the preposition y 'to' · also soft after y 'its' (yn y wneuthur 'in the making of it'), the possessive standing for the object
__broaden__.dyrchauael: dyrchafael (dyrchafu) — to raise, lift up; verbal noun (dyrchauael taryan 'raising a shield'; yn dyrchauael 'rising, prospering'); no mutation · also after y 'its' (yn y dyrchauael 'in the raising of it'); the softening (d>dd) is not shown in the spelling
__broaden__.wyd: gwyd (cf. gwedd) — manner, way; noun, soft-mutated after llyma (Llyma wyd y kyffy 'here is the way you will get it') · also 'presence, keeping' (gwydd), soft after dy 'your' (y'th wyd di 'to your presence, into your keeping') · also soft after y 'his' (yn y wyd 'in his keeping, in his presence'; a little uncertain)
__broaden__.iawn: iawn — right, proper, correct; adjective/predicate (iawn yw gymryt 'it is right to receive') · also noun 'compensation, redress, amends' (dy iawn 'your compensation'; chael iawn 'getting redress') · also 'right (thing)' as object of gwneuthur (phei gwnelut iawn 'and if you were to do right')
__broaden__.ellwng: gollwng (gollwng) — to loose, release; verbal noun (ellwng e gwn 'to loose his hounds') · also 2 sg. imperative 'release!' (Ellwng ef 'Release it')
__broaden__.i: i — (1) emphatic independent pronoun 'I/me', echoing a verb or conjugated preposition (rof i, arnaf i); (2) spelling of y 'to' before a vowel or l/w (i waret); (3) spelling of y 'his' before some words (i wisc hela 'his hunting-dress') · (4) after ohonawch, probably the 2 pl. echoing pronoun chwi with its ch run into the ending (ohonawch i 'of you') · also echoing a possessive (wy gwreic i yw hi 'she is my wife')
__broaden__.wy: wynt (hwynt) — they; 3 pl. pronoun, spelling variant (heb wy 'said they') · also emphatic 'them' after a conjugated preposition (ganthunt wy 'from them', ohonunt wy 'of them') · also 'them' as object, resuming the infixed -s (bei as caffwnn i wy oll 'if I were to get them all') · also a spelling of uy 'my' (wy gwreic i 'my wife'; the nasal mutation is not written)
__broaden__.achaws: achaws (achos) — cause, reason; noun m. ('Pa achaws' 'what reason, why') · also in o achaws 'because of' (o achaws y carchar hwnnw 'because of that prison')
__broaden__.uot: bot (bod) — to be; verbal noun, soft-mutated after a (ef a eill uot yn ediuar gennyf) · also soft as the complement of a verb (a dylyei uot 'that ought to be') · also soft-mutated after y 'his' (y uot yn colli 'that he was losing', lit. 'his being losing') · also soft after dy 'your' (dy uot yn kyuanhedu 'your being settled')
__broaden__.orssed: gorssed (gorsedd) — mound; noun f., g lost by soft mutation after the article, as a feminine noun (yr orssed 'the mound', y'r orssed 'to the mound') · also soft (g lost) as the object after the verb and its subject pronoun (y kyrchwys ef Orssed Arberth 'he made for Gorsedd Arberth'), as the first element of a place-name
__broaden__.kyn: kyn (cyn) — before; with a verbal noun (kyn uy rodi 'before my being given') · also the equative particle 'as', softening the adjective (kyn debycket a'r mab 'as like as the boy') · also 'although', with the subjunctive (Kyn ny bwyf arglwydes 'though I am not a lady') · also in kyn no hynny 'before that' (seith mlyned kyn no hynny 'seven years before that')
__broaden__.no: no (na) — than, comparative particle (no gyrru 'than driving'; no chyuedach) · also in kyn no hynny 'before that, earlier than that'
__broaden__.pan: pan (pan) — when; temporal conjunction with a past-time clause (pan doeth) · also interrogative 'from where, whence' (pan doy di? 'where do you come from?') · also 'from where' as a relative (Pan doaf o Loygyr 'from where I come, from England')
__broaden__.welsei: gwelet (gweld) — to see; 3 sg. pluperfect 'had seen', soft-mutated after o'r a (o'r a welsei ef) · also soft after the negatives na and ny (hyt na welsei dyn 'so that no man had seen'; ny welsei dyn) · also soft after yr pan 'since' (yr pan welsei ef 'since he had seen')
__broaden__.na: na — (1) negative particle in a subordinate clause, 'not' (na dywedy di); (2) 'neither/nor' in a series (na guas ystauell, na swydawc) · also negative imperative 'do not', with soft mutation (na ouyn di 'do not ask'; na yrrwch geu arnaf 'do not lay a lie on me'; na hawl ef 'do not claim him') · also 'not' in a main-clause denial or refusal, with soft mutation (na ellynghaf 'I will not release'; na uynhaf 'I will not have it'; na weleis 'I have not seen')
__broaden__.golles: colli (colli) — to lose; here without an object, 'be lost'; 3 sg. preterite (neur golles y mab 'the boy has been lost'); soft-mutated (c>g) after neur (neu + the perfective ry) · also soft-mutated after yny 'until' (yny golles y deu 'until he lost the two', transitive)
__broaden__.loygyr: Proper name — Lloegr, England (spelt Loygyr); softened (ll>l) as the object straight after the verb (Kyrchwn Loygyr 'let us make for England') · also soft (ll>l) after o 'from' (o Loygyr 'from England')
__broaden__.onyt: onyt (onid) — unless; conjunction (onyt ti a'm gwrthyt 'unless (it be) you (who) reject me') · also 'except, but' (un dyn yma onyt pedwar dyn 'one man here except four men')
__broaden__.weith: gwaith (gwaith) — work, make, pattern, manner; noun m. (MW gweith); g lost by soft mutation after ar (ar weith taryaneu da 'after the pattern of good shields, on the work of good shields'); the sense 'manner, pattern' is a little uncertain · also soft-mutated (gw>w) as the object of welsynt (y lle ny welsynt eiryoet weith 'where they had never seen work'); gweith 'time' is possible but less likely · also soft after ryw 'kind of' (pa ryw weith 'what kind of work') and after y (gohir ar y weith 'delay over the work')
__broaden__.guir: gwir (gwir) — truth, true; noun m., fronted object (guir a dyweit 'he speaks truth') · also predicate 'true' (Guir yw 'it is true')
__broaden__.deir: tri (tri) — three; feminine form teir (tair), written deir; soft-mutated (t>d) after 'e 'his' (a'e deir grofd 'and his three crofts') · also softened (t>d) as the object of the verb with it 'to you' standing between (mi a rodaf it deir punt 'I will give you three pounds'); the Red Book has teirpunt unsoftened, and pedeirpunt is unsoftened in the same position, so the rule is not applied every time
__broaden__.hwnn: hwnn (hwn) — 'this' (m.); demonstrative (yr oet hwnn 'this appointment') · also pronoun 'the one that' (namyn yr hwnn a dyly 'but that which it deserves')
__broaden__.llinin: llinyn (llinyn) — string, cord, thread; noun m., spelt llinin (ac a llinin 'and with a string'); radical after a 'with' · also radical after the article y (maglu y llinin 'to noose the cord')
__broaden__.uynwgyl: mynwgyl (mynwgl) — neck; noun m., soft-mutated after am (am y uynwgyl 'about his neck') · also soft directly after am (maglu y llinin am uynwgyl y llygoden 'to noose the cord about the mouse's neck')
__broaden__.ty: ty (tŷ) — house; noun m. (yn y ty yd oed cassec 'in the house was a mare'); no mutation · also 'you', emphatic 2 sg. pronoun after the verb (yd wyt ty yndaw 'you are in it')
__broaden__.uu: bot (bod) — to be; 3 sg. preterite 'was' (bu), soft-mutated after a (tirionwch... a uu y ryngthunt) · also soft-mutated after tra 'while' (tra uu da ganthunt 'while it was good with them') · also soft-mutated after yny 'until' (yny uu damunet gantunt 'until there was desire in them') and as after the relative a left unwritten (A hwnnw uu y trydyd dyn 'and that one was the third man') · also 'she was' after a fronted predicate, the relative a understood (a lleidyr uu hi arnaf i 'and a thief she was against me')
__broaden__.can: can — hundred; numeral, also 'white' (Hafgan = haf + can 'summer-white'); here in guerth can carw 'the worth of a hundred stags' · also can 'since, because' (can doethwyf i 'since I have come')
__broaden__.arall: arall — other, another; adjective (yr erchwys arall 'the other pack') · also pronoun 'another (woman)' (heb arall 'said another') · also 'again, more' after kymeint (y gymeint arall 'as much again')
__broaden__.doy: dyuot (dod) — to come; 2 sg. present 'you come' (pan doy di 'where do you come from?') · also 3 sg. imperfect 'would come', a variant of doey (ny doy gof udunt wy dim 'no memory of anything came to them') · the same 3 sg. imperfect 'would come' (ef a doy am dy benn 'it would come upon your head'; the Red Book has ef a doei)
__broaden__.llwyt: llwyt (llwyd) — grey; adjective (brethyn llwyt 'grey cloth') · also proper name Llwyt (Llwyd) (Miui yw Llwyt uab Kil Coet 'I am Llwyd son of Cil Coed')
__broaden__.gedymdeithas: kedymdeithas (cydymdeithas) — fellowship, companionship; noun f., soft-mutated after y (kedymdeithas y ryngthunt 'fellowship between them') · also soft after o 'out of' (o gedymdeithas ac ef 'out of fellowship with him')
__broaden__.uyn: mynnu (mynnu) — to wish, want; 3 sg. present 'wants' (A uyn ef dyuot y'r tir 'does he want to come ashore?'); soft-mutated (m>u) after the interrogative particle a · also uy (fy) 'my', with the nasal mutation of d- written as n on the possessive (uyn diua i 'my destruction') · also before teulu (uyn teulu 'my warband'), the n of the nasal mutation being written on the possessive
__broaden__.yd: yd — preverbal particle used when the clause opens with an adverb rather than the subject, introducing an indicative main verb (A threigylgweith yd oed yn Arberth) · also yd 'corn, grain' noun m. (y diua dy yd 'to destroy your corn')
__broaden__.hunein: hun (hun) — self; plural hunein (modern hunain) in ny hunein 'ourselves' (arnam ny hunein 'on ourselves'); pronoun/noun; no mutation · also 'themselves' (uyn teulu e hunein 'my warband themselves')
__broaden__.ueichawc: beichawc (beichiog) — pregnant, burdened; adjective (uy mot y ueichawc 'that I was pregnant'); soft-mutated (b>u) after the predicative particle y (yn) · also soft after bei (phy na bei ueichawc hi 'and if she were not pregnant'), as the complement after the verb
__broaden__.benn: penn (pen) — head, top, end; noun m.; soft-mutated (p>b) after ar 'on' (ar benn gossed 'on top of a mound'; ar benn y pethewnos 'at the end of the fortnight') · also soft after y 'his' (gauas y benn 'found his head') and after am 'about' (am benn hwnnw 'about that one's head') · also soft after a preceding adjective (Yspydawt Urdaul Benn 'the Hospitality of the Honoured Head') and after the feminine noun yspydawt (Yspydaut Benn 'the Hospitality of the Head') · also soft-mutated (p>b) after uch 'above' (uch benn llech 'above a slab') · also soft after dy 'your' (am dy benn 'about your head')
__broaden__.gwbyl: cwbyl (cwbl) — whole, complete; adjective; soft-mutated (c>g) as the predicate after uu (yny uu gwbyl idaw y dal 'until his payment was complete to him') · also soft-mutated (c>g) as object after ry geueist (neu ry geueist gwbyl 'you have got the whole')
__broaden__.edrych: edrych (edrych) — to look; verbal noun (edrych ar y carw 'to look at the stag') · also imperative 'look!' (Edrych i'th gylch 'look around you') and 3 sg. present (A phan edrych 'and when he looked', the bare stem as vivid present; the Red Book a phan edrychawd ef)
__broaden__.gylch: kylch (cylch) — circle, circuit, surrounding; noun m. (yn y gylch 'about him'); soft-mutated (k>g) after the possessive y 'his' · also soft after 'th 'your' (i'th gylch 'around you')
__broaden__.kyuanhed: cyfanhedd (cyfanhedd) — dwelling, habitation, inhabited place; noun m. (y kyuanhed 'the dwellings'; ay ty ay kyuanhed 'either house or dwelling'); radical after the article y; cf. the adjective gyuanhedach · also adjective 'inhabited' (yn gyuanhed 'inhabited'), soft after yn (c>g)
__broaden__.uarch: march (march) — horse; noun m., soft-mutated after ar (y ar uarch erchlas mawr 'on a big dapple-grey horse') · also soft-mutated after y 'his' (y uarch 'his horse') · also soft after o 'of' (a wely o uarch 'whatever you see of horses')
__broaden__.ony: ony (oni) — unless, until; conjunction ('no, unless …'), causes spirant mutation of c, p, t (ony chyuyt 'unless there rise') · also with soft mutation of g (ony wybydaf i 'if I do not find out') · also 'if not' with the subjunctive (ony bei hagyr 'if it were not unseemly')
__broaden__.dala: dala (dal) — to hold, seize, take on; verbal noun (dechreuis gwyr y wlat dala trymuryt 'the men of the land began to take sorrow'); no mutation · also with 'y 'her' before it (a'y dala hi 'and her being caught'; the sense of the clause is a little uncertain)
__broaden__.gehy: caffael (cael) — to get; 2 sg. present/future 'you will get' (ti a gehy ychwanegu 'you will get an increase'); soft-mutated (c>g) after the particle a · also in ti a gehy hynny 'you will get that'; gehy is a by-form of gey/key (the Red Book has Ti a gey here)
__broaden__.mynny: mynnu (mynnu) — to want, wish; 2 sg. present 'you wish' (y mynny di 'that you wish') · also left unsoftened after cany 'since … not' (Cany mynny hynny 'since you do not want that'; the Red Book also mynny)
__broaden__.cany: cany — 'since … not'; conjunction can 'since' + the negative ny, softening the verb (Cany welas ef 'since he did not see') · also with the verb left unsoftened (Cany mynny hynny 'since you do not want that'; the Red Book likewise)
__broaden__.guare: gware (chwarae) — to play, play with; verbal noun, spelt guare (guare a'r got 'to play with the bag'; guare broch yg got 'the game of badger in the bag') · also noun 'game, sport, trick' (y tremic hwnnw a'r guare 'that insult and the sport') · also as an object left unsoftened after the subject i (y dieleis i guare broch yghot 'I avenged the game of badger in the bag'; the Red Book gware)
__broaden__.yrdaw: yr (er) + ef — 'for him, for his sake'; conjugated preposition, 3 sg. m. (a wnaethom yrdaw ef 'what we did for him'); no mutation · also 'for it', of a thing (seith punt it yrdaw 'seven pounds for it', the creature, pryf m.)
__broaden__.kanys: kanys (canys) — because, for, since; conjunction (Kanys y noss y keueist y mab 'for the night you got the boy'); no mutation · also for kan 'since' + nys 'not … it' (Kanys gollyngy yr hynny 'since you will not release it for that'; the Red Book Kan nys gollynghy); radical after the infixed 's
__broaden__.canys: canys — since, for, because; conjunction (canys dechreueist uy llad 'since you have begun to kill me') · also for kan 'since' + nys 'not … it' (Canys collyghy yr hynny 'since you will not release it for that'; the Red Book Kan nys gellyngy) · also plain affirmative 'since' (A chanys bu 'and since she was')
__broaden__.tryded: trydyd (trydydd) — third; ordinal, feminine form tryded (trydedd) (A honno oed tryded prif rieni 'and she was the third chief ...'); no mutation (soft mutation after predicative yn is not written: yn tryded) · also left unsoftened after the article before a feminine noun, where dryded would be expected (A'r tryded nos 'and the third night'; the Red Book likewise)
__broaden__.uydwn: bot (bod) — to be; 1 pl. future 'we will be', soft-mutated (b > u) after the relative a (Ni a uydwn drostaw 'we will stand for him') · also 1 sg. imperfect, conditional 'I would be', soft-mutated after the particle a (mi a uydwn wrth dy gynghor 'I would be by your counsel')
__broaden__.herbyn: erbyn (erbyn) — meeting; in yn y herbyn 'to meet her', with h- before the vowel after y 'her' · also yn eu herbyn 'to meet them', with h- after eu 'their'
__broaden__.gwnn: gwybot (gwybod) — to know; 1 sg. present 'I know', g often dropped after ny (ny wnn i 'I do not know') · also radical after the infixed 's (a chanys gwnn 'and since I do not know it', kan + nys)
